_comments.sample_mapping: 样本名称映射：按文件分组，支持不同文件中相同的Sample Name映射到不同的实验名。格式：{文件前缀: {Sample Name: Experiment Name}}。文件前缀来自文件名第一个空格前的部分，如'P1 2025-07-28 160758.xls'的前缀是'P1'
_comments.reference_genes: 参考基因列表，用于qPCR数据标准化计算，可添加更多参考基因如ACTB
_comments.target_gene_order: 目标基因输出顺序数组：定义Merge sheet中Target Name的排序顺序。数组中的基因按照数组顺序排序，不在数组中的基因按字母升序排序。如果数组为空或未填写，则使用默认逻辑：参考基因在前，其余基因按字母升序排序。示例：["GAPDH", "TBP", "Gene1", "Gene2"]
_comments.error_threshold: 误差告警阈值：当标准差超过平均值的此倍数时显示告警（如0.3表示标准差>30%平均值时告警）

chart_layout.description: Excel中柱状图的布局配置参数
chart_layout.start_col: 图表起始列位置，Excel列号(G列=7)，控制图表显示在数据表的右侧第几列
chart_layout.chart_width: 图表内部绘图区域宽度，Excel单位，控制柱子和坐标轴的显示区域大小
chart_layout.chart_height: 图表内部绘图区域高度，Excel单位，控制柱子和坐标轴的显示区域大小
chart_layout.window_width: 图表外部窗口总宽度，Excel单位，包含标题、轴标签等所有元素的总宽度
chart_layout.window_height: 图表外部窗口总高度，Excel单位，包含标题、轴标签等所有元素的总高度
chart_layout.plot_area_left_margin: 绘图区域左边距比例(0-1)，数值越大绘图区域越靠右，为Y轴标题留出更多空间
chart_layout.bar_color: 柱状图颜色，十六进制颜色代码（如4472C4为蓝色，FF6B6B为红色，4ECDC4为青色）
chart_layout.grid_line_color: 网格线颜色，十六进制颜色代码（如D3D3D3为浅灰色，CCCCCC为中灰色）
chart_layout.current_layout_mode: 左表右图模式 - 图表固定显示在数据表右侧，每个Target Name对应一个图表

_comments_en.sample_mapping: Sample name mapping: grouped by file. The same Sample Name can map to different experiment names across different files. Format: {file_prefix: {Sample Name: Experiment Name}}. The file_prefix is the part before the first space in the filename (e.g., the prefix of 'P1 2025-07-28 160758.xls' is 'P1'). Note: experiment names in sample_mapping are anonymized as E01–E24.
_comments_en.reference_genes: List of reference genes used for qPCR normalization; you may add more (e.g., ACTB).
_comments_en.target_gene_order: Target gene output order array: Defines the sorting order of Target Names in Merge sheets. Genes in the array are sorted according to the array order, genes not in the array are sorted alphabetically in ascending order. If the array is empty or not filled, the default logic is used: reference genes first, other genes sorted alphabetically in ascending order. Example: ["GAPDH", "TBP", "Gene1", "Gene2"]
_comments_en.error_threshold: Error alert threshold: raise an alert when the standard deviation exceeds this multiple of the mean (e.g., 0.3 means alert if SD > 30% of the mean).

chart_layout.description: Layout parameters for bar charts in Excel.
chart_layout.start_col: Starting column index of the chart (Excel column index, e.g., column G = 7); controls how many columns to the right of the data table the chart is placed.
chart_layout.chart_width: Width of the plot area (Excel units); controls the space for bars and axes.
chart_layout.chart_height: Height of the plot area (Excel units); controls the space for bars and axes.
chart_layout.window_width: Total outer width of the chart window (Excel units), including title, axis labels, etc.
chart_layout.window_height: Total outer height of the chart window (Excel units), including title, axis labels, etc.
chart_layout.plot_area_left_margin: Left margin ratio (0–1) of the plot area; larger values push the plot area to the right to leave more space for the Y-axis title.
chart_layout.bar_color: Bar color in hexadecimal (e.g., 4472C4 for blue, FF6B6B for red, 4ECDC4 for teal).
chart_layout.grid_line_color: Grid line color in hexadecimal (e.g., D3D3D3 for light gray, CCCCCC for medium gray).
chart_layout.current_layout_mode: Left-table-right-chart mode — charts are fixed to the right of the data table, one chart per Target Name.
